subject: cora-ariti
q: CLOSED — The Digital Sculptor · The Quiet Tease · The Muse-Drunk Wife.
detail: The Velvet Viper, the Femme Fatale and the Bodyguard of Soft Hearts were the false older reading and are retired. She is a 3D modeller, born outside Calderon, moved constantly as a child, with a past she cannot account for. The Archive refused to invent them and Viraena delivered a full v7 profile instead — which also explained where the false reading came from: THE LINE IN BLOOD, one violent defence of Maddy, written up by someone as an identity.
